research_notes: A runtime failure boundary discovered under one product/runtime configuration may change with model or platform updates.
Therefore the final contract should treat cap evidence as versioned/refreshable rather than immutable forever.
Periodic lightweight revalidation near the cap may be worthwhile later, but it should not consume normal work capacity excessively.
Rollback handles unexpected degradation between revalidations.
The current experiment establishes the initial baseline for the present environment.
No claim of permanence will be made.
